name: Maeriel Fenbough
source_profile: ● Maeriel Fenbough (LN) is Elaris's niece and principal diplomatic emissary. She has studied Cadorian law and believes the Velthari should demand written royal guarantees rather than depend on agreements with individual marquises.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 65 (source excerpt; may be partial)
